breaking_news.headline: Smart-ring maker Oura delays its IPO citing market uncertainty
breaking_news.summary: The leading smart ring manufacturer says the delay is "despite strong demand." It was betting its trove of health data would be a hit with Wall Street.

breaking_news.headline: What we know about the suspected U.K. terror plot. And, why the Gulf remains in limbo
breaking_news.summary: What we know — and still don't — about the suspected terror plot near a U.K. air base. Trump rejects Iran's offer to pause fighting. And CNN prepares for new owners with ties to Trump.

breaking_news.headline: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
breaking_news.summary: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.

breaking_news.headline: News organizations ask court to bar White House enforcement of access ban
breaking_news.summary: Three news outlets that President Trump banished from White House grounds asked a federal court to block the ban until the case is resolved.

breaking_news.headline: Democrat Pete Buttigieg criticizes Trump's rollback of fuel-economy standards
breaking_news.summary: The former transportation secretary says weaker fuel-economy standards could raise long-term costs for drivers and leave U.S. automakers further behind China.

breaking_news.headline: How to hide your spending habits from retailers (so you don't get ripped off)
breaking_news.summary: Companies have changed the way they price their products — and shoppers are getting deliberately overcharged. Here are steps you can take to ensure you are getting the best deal.

breaking_news.headline: One year after the end of the EV tax credit, is the future still electric?
breaking_news.summary: Congress got rid of a $7,500 federal tax credit for new electric vehicle buyers. One year later, are people still buying EVs?

breaking_news.headline: A startup wants to build a massive nuclear-powered data center on public land in Utah
breaking_news.summary: Valar Atomics wants to place over 450 reactors on more than 9,500 acres in Utah to power a huge data center project.

breaking_news.headline: Africa's richest man launches Kenya oil refinery despite land protests
breaking_news.summary: The Kenya refinery is part of Dangote's ambitious bid to expand and help industralise Africa by 2030.

breaking_news.headline: Huel ad banned for suggesting its products could replace all meals
breaking_news.summary: The advertising watchdog said that viewers could assume from the ad that replacing all normal food with Huel was "nutritionally appropriate".

breaking_news.headline: The start-ups hoping to return battery making to the US
breaking_news.summary: Batteries based on sodium-ion technology could be made in the US with locally sourced materials.

breaking_news.headline: Doubters spur me on: why more women are taking up DIY
breaking_news.summary: Female DIY experts and tradeswomen talk about their experiences of a traditionally male-dominated domain.

breaking_news.headline: Three takeaways from Trump's 'Super Intelligence' summit
breaking_news.summary: The meeting at the White House came as some tech bosses and experts have called for tighter rules around AI.

breaking_news.headline: Greggs to shut four factories and cut 740 jobs
breaking_news.summary: The company says it needs to "keep evolving alongside changing customer expectations".

breaking_news.headline: Regulating AI 'not the right place to start' says Bailey
breaking_news.summary: AI needs "rigorous" testing and safeguards to contain risk, Andrew Bailey says.

breaking_news.headline: Household energy bills forecast to see biggest rise in four years
breaking_news.summary: A typical household faces an annual gas and electricity bill of £1,999 from January, based on a key forecast.

breaking_news.headline: ‘I’d rather be on a beach in Bali’: My husband resents my $8 million net worth. Should I pay for his retirement?
breaking_news.summary: “We have an ironclad prenup.”
